component.name: OpenHeadset Control
component.summary: Réglages du casque Sennheiser MOMENTUM 5 (non officiel)

description.p: Lightweight desktop control of the Sennheiser MOMENTUM 5 headphones, as an alternative to the mobile app: noise cancellation, ANC ↔ transparency slider, wind reduction, spatial audio, 8-band equalizer and presets, scenes, battery history, global shortcuts and a system tray icon. The interface is in French.

Contrôle léger du casque Sennheiser MOMENTUM 5 depuis le bureau, en alternative à l'application mobile : réduction de bruit, curseur ANC ↔ transparence, anti-vent, audio spatial, égaliseur 8 bandes et préréglages, scènes, historique de la batterie, raccourcis globaux et icône de la zone de notification.

Unofficial project, not affiliated with Sennheiser or Sonova. Only writes captured and then verified on the headphones are sent, and only to the validated model and firmware; any other headphones stay read-only. No firmware update, no factory reset.

Projet non officiel, sans lien avec Sennheiser ni Sonova. Seules les écritures capturées puis vérifiées sur le casque sont envoyées, et uniquement au modèle et au micrologiciel validés ; tout autre casque reste en lecture seule. Ni mise à jour du micrologiciel, ni réinitialisation d'usine.

Measured battery life (also per noise cancelling mode), local event log, notifications of your choice including "headphones on without sound", automatic scenes on connection or at a set time, and curve export for Equalizer APO.
First stable release: written version policy (settings files, JSON backup, command line and D-Bus API stay compatible across 1.x), security policy, and an optional new version notice, off by default.
Interfaces in English, accessibility (screen reader names, keyboard navigation, contrast), first-launch assistant, one-click bug report, user guide and FAQ.
Reliability release: user files protected against concurrent writes and failed saves, Linux service confinement corrected.
Flatpak built offline from pinned sources, new application ID, reviewed permissions and settings migration.
